title: CraftMine Reimagined
description: This is a mod inspired by the April Fools' version "CraftMine".
body:
This mod adds over 14 new dimensions to explore, along with 20 new items, more than 15 new blocks, unique structures, 12 crafting recipes, and much more to discover. It significantly expands your Minecraft experience with new content, mechanics, and adventures.
Among the new dimensions, you will find the Water Dimension, a world made entirely of water, and the Lava Dimension, completely filled with lava. Each dimension offers unique challenges and exploration opportunities.
New content also includes the Mother Barrier structure, a powerful and mysterious structure, and the Barrier Breaker, a special tool capable of disintegrating and dropping any block in the game.
Additionally, the mod introduces 5 Blocks of Infinity, each granting unique effects when used or interacted with, adding new possibilities for progression and gameplay customization.
To begin your journey, you must use a Reactivator. There are several types available, such as the Random Reactivator, Dimensional Reactivator, Lush Reactivator, and others.
You can also customize your starting lobby using materials like diamond, emerald, gold, or dimensional dust.
To help balance progression, you receive five random reactivators—one per death—to prevent you from losing your world entirely. Crafting additional Dimensional and Random Reactivators is highly recommended to avoid losing progress.
Good luck exploring the unknown!![Dimensional Reactiver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3d3dcb0d4742e868c55935fb64a36126660165a_0.webp)
